Check In · First class of the week

Weekly Check-In Form

Rate 3 questions, 1 to 5. Be honest.

Type your goal tool in “Which tool?”

Check In

Energy Check

Show your energy: 1 to 5 on your fingers.

ORI Time · 10 minutes 💻

ORI Time

Log in at app.orilearning.com.

Keep going on your lesson.

Last Time · Explain & Apply

Last Time: My Goal

󾠮 Explain your goal in one sentence.

󾠯 Apply: It's Friday at lunch. Your trigger happens. Walk us through

exactly what you do.

󾠰 What if it doesn't help?

Learn

Plan A or Plan B?

🅰 Plan A = my goal tool.

🔄 Switch to Plan B when:

❌ I can't do Plan A here, or

😣 I tried it and it didn't help.

🅱 Plan B = my backup tool or asking an adult.

🃏 Card 1 of 4

Math test. You feel frustrated.

Plan A: box breathing at your desk. It's quiet, and you can do it

without anyone noticing.

☝ 🅰 Plan A works   Switch to Plan B

Vote!  

✅ Answer · Card 1 of 4 🅰

Plan A Works!

Box breathing works quietly at a desk.

🃏 Card 2 of 4

Loud gym. Someone bumps you hard.

Plan A: 5-4-3-2-1 grounding. It's too loud and busy to focus.

☝ 🅰 Plan A works   Switch to Plan B

Vote!  

✅ Answer · Card 2 of 4 🔄

Switch to Plan B!

Too noisy to focus. Plan B: squeeze and release, or ask for a reset

pass.

🃏 Card 3 of 4

Job site. A long line of customers. You

feel rushed.

Plan A: walk to the break room. You can't leave the register right

now.

☝ 🅰 Plan A works   Switch to Plan B

Vote!  

✅ Answer · Card 3 of 4 🔄

Switch to Plan B!

You can't leave. Plan B: box breathing or squeeze and release right

there, then tell your supervisor at break.

🃏 Card 4 of 4

Lunch. A friend says something rude.

Plan A: cool thoughts: “It's not worth it.” You try it, and your

shoulders relax.

☝ 🅰 Plan A works   Switch to Plan B

Vote!  

✅ Answer · Card 4 of 4 🅰

Plan A Works!

Your body calmed down. Plan A worked!

Recap

Recap: Read Together

🅰 Plan A works

🔄 Switch to Plan B

📝 Math test → box breathing

🏀 Loud gym → too noisy to focus

🥪 Lunch → cool thoughts

🛒 Busy job → can't leave

🅱 Asking an adult counts!

Always have a Plan B.

Practice

Act It Out

Pick one card with your partner.

Act it out with YOUR goal tool.

Say your Plan B out loud.

Switch roles.

Practice

Fix My Goal Card

Is your Plan B written down?

Does it work at school AND at work?

Fix one thing if needed.

Project · Comic Share 📖

Author's Chair

Share 1 comic panel.

Tell us: What's the reset?

Audience: clap and say one thing you liked.

You can pass.

Project

File It

Comic goes in your Toolkit Binder.

Goal card stays behind your Reset Plan.

Closing

Exit Line

“This week I'll use ___ when ___.”

Say it to a partner, or write it on the strip.

See you Thursday! 👋

Great Work!

Pocket card in your pocket.

Thursday: we close the unit.

Binders on the shelf.
